source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Unit 3 (PDF 39-48), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 3 (Theory of Quadratic Functions) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define a quadratic function and write its standard form.
(Quadratic function ki definition likhein aur us ki standard form likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Quadratic function degree do ka polynomial function hai: \(f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c\), jahan \(a, b, c\) real numbers hain aur \(a \ne 0\). \(a\) leading coefficient (sab se aage wala coefficient), \(b\) \(x\) ka coefficient, \(c\) constant term hai.

book_ref.quote: It is typically expressed in the standard form

blocks.prompt:
2 Write \(f(x) = 7 - 2x^{2}\) in standard form and read off \(a\), \(b\) and \(c\).
(\(f(x) = 7 - 2x^{2}\) ko standard form mein likhein aur \(a\), \(b\), \(c\) batayein.)

book_ref.quote: The three numbers have names

blocks.prompt:
3 Why is the condition \(a \ne 0\) necessary in \(f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c\)?
(\(f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c\) mein shart \(a \ne 0\) kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar \(a = 0\) ho to \(x^{2}\) wala term khatam ho jata hai aur \(f(x) = bx + c\) linear (seedhi line) ban jata hai, quadratic nahi. Misal: \(0x^{2} + 4x - 2 = 4x - 2\).

book_ref.quote: is a linear function (a straight line), not a quadratic one

blocks.prompt:
4 For which values of \(k\) is \(f(x) = (k - 3)x^{2} + 5x - 1\) a quadratic function?
(\(k\) ki kin qeematon ke liye \(f(x) = (k - 3)x^{2} + 5x - 1\) quadratic function hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh quadratic tab hai jab \(x^{2}\) ka coefficient zero na ho: \(k - 3 \ne 0\), yani \(k \ne 3\). \(k = 3\) par \(f(x) = 5x - 1\) linear hai.

book_ref.quote: means the highest power of \(x\) is 2

blocks.prompt:
5 Why does the sign of \(a\) decide whether the parabola \(y = ax^{2} + bx + c\) opens upward or downward?
(\(a\) ka nishan kyun tay karta hai ke parabola \(y = ax^{2} + bx + c\) upar khulega ya neeche?)
blocks.explanation: Bari \(x\) (positive ya negative) par \(ax^{2}\), \(bx + c\) se bohat bara hota hai. Agar \(a > 0\) ho to dono siron par yeh bara aur positive hai, is liye dono baazu upar (sab se neecha point); agar \(a < 0\) ho to dono baazu neeche (sab se ooncha point).

book_ref.quote: For large values of \(x\) (positive or negative)

blocks.prompt:
6 Find the \(y\)-intercept, the \(x\)-intercepts and the vertex of \(y = x^{2} - 4x + 3\). Is the vertex a maximum or a minimum point?
(\(y = x^{2} - 4x + 3\) ka \(y\)-intercept, \(x\)-intercepts aur vertex maloom karein. Vertex maximum point hai ya minimum?)
blocks.explanation: Teen khaas points maloom karein, phir \(a\) ka nishan dekhein.

book_ref.quote: For analyzing the sketch of quadratic function

blocks.prompt:
7 For \(y = -x^{2} + 2x + 8\), find the vertex and the intervals where the function is increasing and decreasing.
(\(y = -x^{2} + 2x + 8\) ka vertex aur woh intervals maloom karein jahan function increasing aur decreasing hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(h = \frac{-b}{2a}\) aur \(k = y(h)\) maloom karein; chunke \(a < 0\), curve \(x = h\) tak upar jata hai aur us ke baad neeche.

book_ref.quote: If \(a < 0\), then the vertex is a maximum point.

blocks.prompt:
8 Find the intervals where \(y = 2x^{2} + 4x - 1\) is decreasing and increasing.
(Woh intervals maloom karein jahan \(y = 2x^{2} + 4x - 1\) decreasing aur increasing hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(h = \frac{-4}{2(2)} = -1\) aur \(a = 2 > 0\), is liye curve pehle neeche phir upar jata hai: \((-\infty, -1)\) par decreasing, \((-1, \infty)\) par increasing.

book_ref.quote: Increasing means: as \(x\) moves to the right

blocks.prompt:
9 A parabola cuts the \(x\)-axis at \(x = 2\) and \(x = 8\). Find its axis of symmetry and explain why.
(Aik parabola \(x\)-axis ko \(x = 2\) aur \(x = 8\) par kaatta hai. Is ka axis of symmetry maloom karein aur wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Graph ko axis par mor dein to dono hisse barabar milte hain, is liye dono \(x\)-intercepts us se barabar faasle par hain. Axis beech mein hai: \(x = \frac{2 + 8}{2} = 5\).

book_ref.quote: means that if you fold the graph along the line

blocks.prompt:
10 Show that the graph of \(y = x^{2} + 2x + 5\) does not touch the \(x\)-axis.
(Sabit karein ke \(y = x^{2} + 2x + 5\) ka graph \(x\)-axis ko nahi chhoota.)
blocks.explanation: \(b^{2} - 4ac = 4 - 20 = -16 < 0\), is liye \(x^{2} + 2x + 5 = 0\) ka koi real root nahi: koi \(x\)-intercept nahi. Vertex \((-1, 4)\) bhi \(x\)-axis se upar minimum point hai.

book_ref.quote: If \(b^{2} - 4ac < 0\) there are none

blocks.text: 3.1.2 Finding Maximum and Minimum Values of Quadratic Functions by Completing Square

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain why \(k\) is the minimum value of \(f(x) = a(x - h)^{2} + k\) when \(a > 0\).
(Wazeh karein ke \(a > 0\) par \(k\), \(f(x) = a(x - h)^{2} + k\) ki minimum qeemat kyun hai.)
blocks.explanation: Har real \(x\) ke liye \((x - h)^{2} \ge 0\), aur yeh sirf \(x = h\) par \(0\) hai. \(a > 0\) ke saath \(a(x - h)^{2} \ge 0\), is liye \(f(x) \ge k\); qeemat \(k\), \(x = h\) par milti hai.

book_ref.quote: A square is never negative

blocks.prompt:
12 Write \(f(x) = x^{2} + 8x + 10\) in vertex form and find its minimum value.
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 8x + 10\) ko vertex form mein likhein aur is ki minimum qeemat maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Square mukammal karein: \(\left(\frac{8}{2}\right)^{2} = 16\) jama aur tafreeq karein.

book_ref.quote: Write the first three terms as a perfect square

blocks.prompt:
13 Find the maximum value of \(f(x) = -3x^{2} + 12x - 7\) by completing the square.
(Completing the square se \(f(x) = -3x^{2} + 12x - 7\) ki maximum qeemat maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) wale terms se \(a = -3\) bahar nikalein, phir andar square mukammal karein.

book_ref.quote: Multiply out the leftover number by \(a\)

blocks.prompt:
14 Use the formulas for \(h\) and \(k\) to find the minimum value of \(f(x) = 4x^{2} - 4x + 3\).
(\(h\) aur \(k\) ke formulas se \(f(x) = 4x^{2} - 4x + 3\) ki minimum qeemat maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Comparing with \(a(x - h)^{2} + k\)

blocks.prompt:
15 For \(f(x) = -(x + 1)^{2} + 6\), differentiate between the maximum value and the point where it occurs.
(\(f(x) = -(x + 1)^{2} + 6\) ke liye maximum qeemat aur us jagah mein farq bayan karein jahan yeh hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ka muqabla neeche hai.

book_ref.quote: the value is \(k\); \(h\) only tells where it occurs

blocks.prompt:
16 Find the minimum value of \(f(x) = x^{2} - 5x + 4\) by completing the square, and check it.
(Completing the square se \(f(x) = x^{2} - 5x + 4\) ki minimum qeemat maloom karein aur jaanchein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\left(\frac{5}{2}\right)^{2} = \frac{25}{4}\) jama aur tafreeq karein, phir \(f(h)\) se jaanchein.

book_ref.quote: Check the answer by finding \(f(h)\)

blocks.prompt:
17 Show that \(f(x) = x^{2} - 6x\) is not one-to-one on all real numbers.
(Sabit karein ke \(f(x) = x^{2} - 6x\) tamam real numbers par one-to-one nahi.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(1) = 1 - 6 = -5\) aur \(f(5) = 25 - 30 = -5\): do mukhtalif inputs, axis \(x = 3\) se barabar faasle par, aik hi output dete hain. Horizontal line \(y = -5\) graph ko do dafa kaatti hai.

book_ref.quote: Horizontal line test (from Unit 2)

blocks.prompt:
18 Find the inverse of \(f(x) = x^{2} - 4\), \(x \ge 0\), with its domain and range.
(\(f(x) = x^{2} - 4\), \(x \ge 0\), ka inverse us ki domain aur range ke saath maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) aur \(y\) badlein, \(y\) hal karein, aur woh nishan rakhein jis ke outputs \(\ge 0\) hon.

book_ref.quote: Solve for \(y\) by the quadratic formula (or by completing the square)

blocks.prompt:
19 Find the inverse of \(f(x) = x^{2} + 6x + 8\), \(x \ge -3\).
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 6x + 8\), \(x \ge -3\), ka inverse maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f\) ko vertex form mein likhein, \(x\) aur \(y\) badlein aur range se nishan chunein.

book_ref.quote: Cutting the parabola at its vertex keeps only one arm

blocks.explanation: \(u = -3 + \sqrt{x + 1}\) ko \(f(u) = (u + 3)^{2} - 1\) mein rakhein: \(f(u) = (\sqrt{x + 1})^{2} - 1 = x + 1 - 1 = x\). Tasdeeq ho gayi.

book_ref.quote: check with \(f(f^{-1}(x)) = x\)

blocks.prompt:
21 For \(f(x) = x^{2} + 6x + 8\), \(x \ge -3\), compare the domain and range of \(f\) and \(f^{-1}\).
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 6x + 8\), \(x \ge -3\), ke liye \(f\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ki domain aur range ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Chunke \(f(x) = (x + 3)^{2} - 1 \ge -1\), Range \(f = [-1, \infty)\). Inverse inhein badal deta hai:

book_ref.quote: Mixing up domain and range of \(f^{-1}\)

blocks.prompt:
22 Define the absolute value of \(x\) and find \(|-7|\), \(|0|\) and \(|4 - 9|\).
(\(x\) ki absolute value ki definition likhein aur \(|-7|\), \(|0|\) aur \(|4 - 9|\) maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: The absolute value of a number is its distance from 0

blocks.prompt:
23 Why is the graph of \(y = |x|\) symmetric about the \(y\)-axis and never below the \(x\)-axis?
(\(y = |x|\) ka graph \(y\)-axis ke gird symmetric kyun hai aur \(x\)-axis se neeche kyun nahi jata?)
blocks.explanation: \(|-x| = |x|\), is liye \(x\) aur \(-x\) aik hi unchai dete hain (maslan \(|-2| = |2| = 2\)). Aur har \(x\) ke liye \(|x| \ge 0\), is liye koi point \(x\)-axis se neeche nahi.

book_ref.quote: The graph is symmetric about the \(y\)-axis because

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between \(|E| < a\) and \(|E| > a\) for \(a > 0\).
(\(a > 0\) ke liye \(|E| < a\) aur \(|E| > a\) mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ka muqabla neeche hai.

book_ref.quote: On the number line: \(|E| < a\) is the part between

rows: \(-a\) aur \(a\) ke bahar wale do hisse

book_ref.quote: means \(E = a\) or \(E = -a\) (written \(E = \pm a\))

blocks.prompt:
26 Is \(|-a| = -a\) always true for a letter \(a\)? Explain.
(Kya kisi harf \(a\) ke liye \(|-a| = -a\) hamesha sahi hai? Wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. \(|-a| = |a|\), jo \(-a\) ke barabar sirf tab hai jab \(a \le 0\). \(a = 3\) par: \(|-3| = 3\) magar \(-a = -3\). \(a = -2\) par: \(|2| = 2 = -a\).

book_ref.quote: this is true only when \(a \le 0\)

blocks.explanation: Absolute value kabhi negative nahi hoti, is liye yeh kabhi \(-2\) ke barabar nahi ho sakti. Solution set \(= \{\ \}\) (koi hal nahi).

book_ref.quote: If \(d < 0\): no solution

blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} - 8 = 1\) ya \(x^{2} - 8 = -1\) mein taqseem karein, dono hal karein aur jaanchein.

book_ref.quote: Each case is an ordinary quadratic equation

blocks.explanation: Do cases; jis case ke real roots na hon use chhor dein.

book_ref.quote: Reject non-real roots; we solve over the real numbers

blocks.explanation: Dono cases hal karein, phir har root jaanchein, kyunke right side mein \(x\) hai.

book_ref.quote: Substitute every root into the original equation and discard any that fail

blocks.prompt:
31 Why must every root be checked in an equation such as \(|x^{2} - 5| = 4x\)?
(\(|x^{2} - 5| = 4x\) jaisi equation mein har root ki jaanch kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Left side kabhi negative nahi, is liye right side \(4x\) ko \(\ge 0\) hona chahiye. Dono cases yeh shart istemal nahi karte, is liye \(x = -1\) jaise roots aa sakte hain jin par \(4x < 0\); yeh extraneous hain aur nikalne zaroori hain.

book_ref.quote: Skipping the check when the right side contains \(x\)

blocks.explanation: \(|E| \le 3\) ka matlab \(-3 \le E \le 3\); dono hisse sahi hone chahiyein.

book_ref.quote: Bring everything to one side and compare with 0

steps: (ii) \(x^{2} - 4 \le 0\): critical numbers \(\pm 2\); test \(x = 0\): \(-4 \le 0\) sahi, is liye \([-2, 2]\)

blocks.explanation: \(|E| > 6\) ka matlab \(E < -6\) ya \(E > 6\); union lein.

book_ref.quote: becomes \(E < -d\) or \(E > d\)

blocks.prompt:
34 Solve \(|x^{2} - 2x| < 3\) and check with one point inside and one outside.
(\(|x^{2} - 2x| < 3\) hal karein aur aik andar aur aik bahar ke point se jaanchein.)
blocks.explanation: \(-3 < x^{2} - 2x < 3\): dono hisse, phir intersection.

book_ref.quote: Check with a point inside and a point outside the final answer

steps: (i) \(x^{2} - 2x + 3 > 0\): \(b^{2} - 4ac = 4 - 12 < 0\) aur \(a > 0\), is liye har \(x\) ke liye sahi

blocks.explanation: \(|E| \ge 5\) ka matlab \(E \le -5\) ya \(E \ge 5\); \(\ge\) ke liye band siray.

book_ref.quote: Open circles and round brackets for strict inequalities

blocks.prompt:
36 Solve \(x^{2} - 5x > -6\), the first part of \(|x^{2} - 5x| < 6\).
(\(x^{2} - 5x > -6\) hal karein, jo \(|x^{2} - 5x| < 6\) ka pehla hissa hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(-6\) ko doosri taraf le jayein: \(x^{2} - 5x + 6 > 0\), yani \((x - 2)(x - 3) > 0\). Test \(0\): \(6 > 0\) sahi; \(2.5\): \(-0.25 > 0\) ghalat; \(4\): \(2 > 0\) sahi. Is liye \(x \in (-\infty, 2) \cup (3, \infty)\).

book_ref.quote: becomes \(E + 3 > 0\), not \(E - 3 > 0\)

(Equation \(\sqrt{x - 1} + \frac{2}{x - 4} = 3\) ki restrictions (pabandiyan) likhein.)

e 4\).

book_ref.quote: an expression under a square root must not be negative

blocks.explanation: Yeh \(x^{2}\) mein quadratic hai: \(y = x^{2}\) rakhein.

book_ref.quote: it is a quadratic in \(x^{2}\)

blocks.prompt:
39 Solve \(x^{4} + 3x^{2} - 4 = 0\) over the real numbers.
(Real numbers par \(x^{4} + 3x^{2} - 4 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(y = x^{2}\) rakhein, \(y\) hal karein, phir \(x\) par wapas aayein.

book_ref.quote: Solving the substituted quadratic

blocks.text: 3.4.1 Rational Equations Reducible to the Quadratic Equation

blocks.prompt:
40 Why can an excluded value never be a solution of a rational equation?
(Excluded qeemat kabhi rational equation ka hal kyun nahi ho sakti?)
blocks.explanation: Excluded qeemat denominator ko zero kar deti hai, aur zero se taqseem defined nahi. Us qeemat par equation be-maani hai, is liye poori nahi ho sakti. Misal: \(\frac{1}{x - 5} = 2\) mein \(x = 5\) excluded hai.

book_ref.quote: Because division by zero is not defined

blocks.explanation: Har term ko LCD \(3(x - 1)(x + 1)\) se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: Expand, bring all terms to one side and get

blocks.explanation: LCD \((x + 1)(x + 4)\) se zarb dein aur quadratic formula lagayein.

book_ref.quote: If the discriminant is not a perfect square
Values that make a denominator zero are excluded from the start

blocks.text: 3.4.2 Radical Equations Reducible to the Quadratic Equation

blocks.prompt:
44 Why can squaring both sides of a radical equation produce extraneous roots?
(Radical equation ke dono taraf square karne se extraneous roots kyun aa sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Agar \(p = q\) ho to \(p^{2} = q^{2}\), magar \(p^{2} = q^{2}\) ka matlab \(p = q\) ya \(p = -q\). Square ki hui equation mein \(p = -q\) ke hal bhi aa jate hain, jo asal equation ko poora nahi karte.

book_ref.quote: If \(p = q\), then certainly \(p^{2} = q^{2}\)

blocks.prompt:
45 Write the conditions on \(x\) for \(\sqrt{x + 3} + \sqrt{5 - x} = 4\).
(\(\sqrt{x + 3} + \sqrt{5 - x} = 4\) ke liye \(x\) par shartein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x + 3 \ge 0 \Rightarrow x \ge -3\) aur \(5 - x \ge 0 \Rightarrow x \le 5\). Is liye \(-3 \le x \le 5\).

book_ref.quote: Note the conditions: every expression

blocks.prompt:
46 Solve \(\sqrt{x + 7} = x + 1\).
(\(\sqrt{x + 7} = x + 1\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono taraf square karein, hal karein, aur dono qeematein asal equation mein jaanchein.

book_ref.quote: Substitute each value in the original equation

blocks.prompt:
47 Solve \(\sqrt{2x + 5} - x = 1\).
(\(\sqrt{2x + 5} - x = 1\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle radical ko akela karein, phir square karein.

book_ref.quote: Isolate one radical on one side (if possible)

blocks.prompt:
48 Solve \(\sqrt{x^{2} + 9} = 5\).
(\(\sqrt{x^{2} + 9} = 5\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Square: \(x^{2} + 9 = 25 \Rightarrow x^{2} = 16 \Rightarrow x = \pm 4\). Jaanch: dono ke liye \(\sqrt{16 + 9} = 5\). Solution set \(= \{\pm 4\}\).

book_ref.quote: Remove the radicals by isolating and squaring

blocks.text: 3.5 Real World Problems of Quadratic Equations and Inequalities

blocks.prompt:
49 The sum of a number and its square is \(56\). Find the number.
(Aik number aur us ke square ka majmua \(56\) hai. Number maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Number \(x\) farz karein: \(x^{2} + x = 56 \Rightarrow x^{2} + x - 56 = 0 \Rightarrow (x + 8)(x - 7) = 0\). Number \(7\) ya \(-8\) hai. Jaanch: \(49 + 7 = 56\), \(64 - 8 = 56\).

book_ref.quote: Translate the problem into symbols and form the equations

blocks.prompt:
50 The product of two consecutive positive even integers is \(168\). Find them.
(Do musalsal positive even integers ka hasil-e-zarb \(168\) hai. Unhein maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Farz karein \(n\) aur \(n + 2\): \(n^{2} + 2n - 168 = 0 \Rightarrow (n + 14)(n - 12) = 0\). Positive hon, is liye \(n = 12\): integers \(12\) aur \(14\) hain (\(12 \times 14 = 168\)).

book_ref.quote: Let the unknown quantity be \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
51 A rectangle has perimeter \(34\) cm and area \(60\) cm\(^{2}\). Find its sides.
(Aik rectangle ka perimeter (ihata) \(34\) cm aur raqba \(60\) cm\(^{2}\) hai. Is ke sides maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik side \(x\) farz karein; doosri \(17 - x\) hogi. Hal karein aur units lagayein.

book_ref.quote: a fraction of a person) and attach units

steps: Dono soorton mein sides \(5\) aur \(12\); jaanch \(2(5 + 12) = 34\), \(5 \times 12 = 60\)

blocks.prompt:
52 A shop's daily profit (in thousands of rupees) is \(P(x) = -x^{2} + 8x - 7\), where \(x\) is the number of items sold (in tens). For which \(x\) is the profit at least \(5\) thousand rupees?
(Aik dukaan ka rozana munafa (hazaar rupay mein) \(P(x) = -x^{2} + 8x - 7\) hai, jahan \(x\) beche gaye items (dahaiyon mein) hain. Kin \(x\) par munafa kam az kam \(5\) hazaar rupay hai?)
blocks.explanation: \"At least\" (kam az kam) ka matlab \(\ge\); \(-1\) se zarb dene par nishan ulat jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Forgetting to reverse the inequality sign when multiplying

blocks.prompt:
53 A stone thrown upward has height \(h = -5t^{2} + 30t\) metres after \(t\) seconds. During which time is it at least \(25\) m high?
(Upar phenka gaya pathar \(t\) seconds baad \(h = -5t^{2} + 30t\) metre ki unchai par hai. Kis waqt ke dauran yeh kam az kam \(25\) m ooncha hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(-5t^{2} + 30t \ge 25 \Rightarrow t^{2} - 6t + 5 \le 0 \Rightarrow (t - 1)(t - 5) \le 0\), is liye \(1 \le t \le 5\). Pathar \(t = 1\) s se \(t = 5\) s tak kam az kam \(25\) m ooncha hai.

book_ref.quote: Solve, then keep only the values that make sense
